_about: Artemis II 是否在 2026-06-30 前完成载人发射并安全返回的冻结证据包。信息截至 2026-03-31；两条 NASA 资料均在截点前发布。

evidence.title: NASA's Artemis II Launch Mission Countdown Begins
evidence.excerpt: The countdown for NASA's Artemis II test flight is underway ... to a targeted launch time on Wednesday, April 1.
evidence.claim: 截至日前 NASA 已进入正式倒计时，说明任务接近实际发射，但尚未完成发射与返回。

evidence.title: NASA Sets Coverage for First Artemis Crewed Mission Around Moon
evidence.excerpt: The agency is targeting no earlier than Wednesday, April 1, for the test flight.
evidence.claim: NASA 3 月 25 日官方确认最早 4 月 1 日发射窗口，为 6 月底前完成任务提供直接进度依据。
